gateways.name: Iiyama Station
gateways.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen station and the local rail head for Nozawa Onsen. The Nozawa Onsen Liner departs from bus stop #4 about 10 minutes after each bullet train arrival.

gateways.name: Nozawa Onsen Bus Terminal
gateways.name_ja: 野沢温泉バスターミナル
gateways.notes: Village's main bus stop, a few minutes' walk from the Hikage gondola base and from Oyu. All buses (Liner, Iiyama, highway) terminate here.

gateways.name: Nagano Station
gateways.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen interchange. Useful when combining Nozawa with Hakuba or the Snow Monkey Park (Yudanaka).

gateways.name: Tokyo Haneda Airport
gateways.notes: Most domestic and regional international flights. ~30 min by Keikyu + JR to Tokyo Station for the Hokuriku Shinkansen onward.

gateways.name: Narita International Airport
gateways.notes: Most long-haul carriers. Allow 1 h for the Narita Express to Tokyo Station, then 100 min Hokuriku Shinkansen to Iiyama.

routes.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen. Hakutaka stops at Iiyama; Kagayaki services skip it, so check before booking.

routes.frequency: every 1–2 h, timed to shinkansen arrivals
routes.notes: Direct express bus from Iiyama Station bus stop #4 to the village. Last bus departs around 19:00; after that take a taxi (~6,000 JPY).
Useful alternative when continuing from Yudanaka / Snow Monkey Park, or when Hakutaka shinkansen schedules don't line up.
Seasonal direct coach. Convenient with ski bags but slower than shinkansen + Liner. Book ahead at naganosnowshuttle.com.

in_resort_transport.name: Mountain Shuttle (Village ↔ Hikage)
in_resort_transport.notes: Free shuttle linking the village center, Furusato-no-Yu and the Hikage gondola base. The village itself is otherwise walkable (and steep) — the shuttle is mostly for the lift run.

in_resort_transport.name: Shinyu Pair Lift
in_resort_transport.notes: Beginner-friendly pair lift at the lower edge of the village; effectively a transport link between the upper village and the Hikage base.
